newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA leaves Australian rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA leaves Australian rates unchanged.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) made no annoucement on official cash rates in its 9.30 a.m. (2230 GMT) market operation annoucement on Wednesday.

There had been speculation in financial markets that the central bank would cut rates as early as this morning following favourable Australian inflation data last week and the RBA Board meeting on Tuesday.
Economists surveyed by Reuters last Friday had put the chance of a February easing at 40 percent, but said the chance of a cut rose to 50 percent after February.
This is mainly because by then the RBA would have more information on wages, including the outcome of the union movement's "living wage" claim, economists said.
The official cash rate currently stands at 6.0 percent, having last been cut by 0.5 percentage point on December 11.
